name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: If Conservatory does not go with Spite, then at least one of Veranda goes with Holloway, Jealousy does not go with Ashford, or Fairfax goes with Inheritance.
Between Holloway and Ravenscroft, one goes with Ballroom and the other with Conservatory.
Either Inheritance goes with Pierce or Ashford goes with Spite.
Between Fairfax and Ravenscroft, one goes with Ballroom and the other with Study.
Jealousy goes with at least one of Pierce or Cellar.
Ballroom goes with either Fairfax or Envy (but not both).
Exactly one of these is true: Holloway goes with Ballroom; Pierce goes with Spite; Veranda goes with Inheritance.
